A husband and wife may make a single return jointly of income taxes, even though one of the spouses has neither gross income nor deductions, except that **no joint return shall be made if either the husband or wife at any time during the taxable year is a nonresident alien.**"

Therefore, at any time during the taxable year 2014 (specifically from Jan 1 to July 9), Alice was a nonresident alien.
